pricing_text: Your request will cost **$0.15** per image. For **$1.00**, you can generate **6** standard images. 4K outputs will be charged at double the standard rate. If web search is used, an additional **$0.015** will be charged. Note: Pricing may change in the future.
notes: $0.15 للصورة القياسية؛ 4K بالضعف ($0.30). بحث الويب إن استُخدم +$0.015. fal ينبّه أن السعر قد يتغير.
